title: Carbon-offset providers
description: Carbon-offset providers an assembly accepts for emissions compensation. Multi-valued — at template time a merchant declares which offset sellers it composes with; at runtime a buyer's commitment carries the same shape with a single-element array reflecting the chosen provider. An order without an offset-policy clause has no offset path. The actual offset purchase is modeled as a sub-order against the chosen provider (seller-registry-bonded as seller); the burn receipt attaches as an attestation against that sub-order.

fields.name: providers
fields.description: Offset providers on offer. klima = Klima DAO, toucan = Toucan Protocol (BCT / NCT), moss = Moss.Earth (MCO2), custom = self-declared offset seller registered against this assembly. At least one must be set when this clause is included.
